description: This file defines the SurveyNotFoundException class, a custom exception used when a survey with a specific ID is not found within the application. It extends a generic resource not found exception to provide specific messaging related to surveys.

classes.name: SurveyNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a survey with the specified ID was not found.

methods.name: SurveyNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new instance of the exception with a message indicating the survey ID not found.
